title: Bend a thin stream
description: Charge a comb and bring it near a thin stream of water or two hanging pieces of foil, and say whether they move.
oneStarDescription: Run a thin stream into a sink.
twoStarDescription: Charge a dry comb on hair or cloth.
threeStarDescription: Bring the comb near the stream or near the hanging foil, and say whether anything moved.

title: Blow across a bottle
description: Blow across a bottle mouth and change the note by changing the water.
oneStarDescription: Produce one note on an empty or partly filled bottle.
twoStarDescription: Add or pour out water and say whether the note moved.
threeStarDescription: Play two notes in an order you announced.

title: Blow one bubble and pop it
description: Dip a loop, blow one bubble, and pop that bubble on purpose.
oneStarDescription: Dip the loop in bubble mix.
twoStarDescription: Blow one bubble free of the loop.
threeStarDescription: Pop the bubble you blew.

title: Bounce a ball under a leg
description: Bounce a ball under one raised leg and catch it.
oneStarDescription: Lift one leg and show the path.
twoStarDescription: Bounce the ball under the leg and catch it.
threeStarDescription: Finish standing with the ball in hand.

title: Bow and stop
description: End a short trick with a bow or a nod and do not add another trick.
oneStarDescription: Complete the one trick you announced.
twoStarDescription: Give one clear bow or nod, then stay still so the ending is finished.
threeStarDescription: Do not start a second trick unless they ask.

title: Braid a short lanyard
description: Braid a short lanyard from three strands and tug the end.
oneStarDescription: Start three strands and make the first crosses.
twoStarDescription: Braid a length you can wear as a loop or hold up.
threeStarDescription: Tie or fuse the end as the material allows and tug it.

title: Bridge-shuffle a small deck
description: Split a small deck, riffle the corners, and bridge the cards back into one pack.
oneStarDescription: Split it into two piles of similar size.
twoStarDescription: Let the corners interleave.
threeStarDescription: Bend and release so the pack becomes one.

title: Build a card bridge
description: Bridge a small gap with cards so a coin can sit on it, or say the gap is too wide.
oneStarDescription: Set the cards across a small gap.
twoStarDescription: Set one coin on the bridge.
threeStarDescription: Say a wider gap you would not try.

title: Build a house of cards
description: Build a house of cards with a base and one story above it.
oneStarDescription: Stand two cards into one A-frame that stays.
twoStarDescription: Lay a flat card and add one frame above, or stop and say the base moved.
threeStarDescription: If it falls, point to the card that went first.

title: Button a cuff
description: Button a cuff, or a spare cuff, with the hand that has to reach it.
oneStarDescription: Hold the button and the hole.
twoStarDescription: Pass the button through the hole.
threeStarDescription: Undo it without pulling the thread.

title: Buzz a lip tone
description: Buzz the lips to make a tone, then stop the tone while the air continues for a moment.
oneStarDescription: Produce one lip buzz a person nearby can hear.
twoStarDescription: Hold the tone long enough for someone to hear.
threeStarDescription: Stop the buzz and show you can be quiet.

title: Carry a tray on one hand
description: Carry a light tray on one flat hand across a short distance.
oneStarDescription: Hold the tray level with one empty cup on it.
twoStarDescription: Walk a few steps. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can walk with it.
threeStarDescription: Set it down without a slide you ignore.

title: Catch a coin from the elbow
description: Place a coin on your elbow and catch it in the same hand.
oneStarDescription: Rest the coin on the bent elbow and show it is still.
twoStarDescription: Straighten the arm and catch the coin.
threeStarDescription: If you miss, show where it went and try once more.

title: Catch a coin off the back of the hand
description: Rest a coin on the back of your hand, toss it, and catch it.
oneStarDescription: Show the coin lying still on the back of the hand.
twoStarDescription: Toss and catch it in the same hand.
threeStarDescription: Open the hand so someone sees the coin.

title: Center a frame on a page
description: Place a rectangle so the margins on the left and right match.
oneStarDescription: Put the rectangle on the page.
twoStarDescription: Write the two side margins.
threeStarDescription: Move it until the two margins match, or say how far off you left it.

title: Check a scale with a known weight
description: Weigh an object whose weight is printed and say whether the scale agrees.
oneStarDescription: Write the weight from the package or the object.
twoStarDescription: Weigh it and write the scale number.
threeStarDescription: Say whether they agree closely enough for your use.

title: Check a square with a 3-4-5 string
description: Lay a 3-4-5 string triangle and say whether a drawn corner matches the right angle.
oneStarDescription: Mark the three lengths on string or tape.
twoStarDescription: Lay it so the right angle sits on the corner you are checking.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the corner matches, or that the string slipped.

title: Clap a round with a partner
description: Clap a short pattern, then have a partner start it while you continue.
oneStarDescription: Clap a pattern of a few hits.
twoStarDescription: Have them start when you are still going.
threeStarDescription: Agree a stop and both stop there.

title: Clap off the beat
description: Tap a steady beat with a foot and clap between the taps.
oneStarDescription: Tap a steady beat with a foot.
twoStarDescription: Clap in the spaces. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can clap off the beat.
threeStarDescription: Keep the foot going and stop the claps.

title: Clap the syllables and stop
description: Clap the syllables of a word and stop when the word ends.
oneStarDescription: Clap one clap for each syllable.
twoStarDescription: Stop when the word ends, with no extra clap.
threeStarDescription: Clap a second word and say which had more syllables.

title: Compare two prints you made
description: Make two prints of your own finger and say one way they match.
oneStarDescription: Ink or pencil-smudge your own finger twice on paper.
twoStarDescription: Point to one ridge or shape that appears in both.
threeStarDescription: Say you are not identifying a person beyond yourself.

title: Complete a cut of the deck
description: Cut a small deck and complete the cut so the original top card is buried.
oneStarDescription: Look at the top card and put it back.
twoStarDescription: Lift part of the deck and set it down.
threeStarDescription: Put the former bottom on top and show the noted card is gone from the top.

title: Conduct four beats
description: Beat a four-pattern in the air and have a partner clap on the first beat.
oneStarDescription: Beat down, in, out, and up where they can see.
twoStarDescription: Repeat the pattern without adding a beat.
threeStarDescription: Have a partner clap only on the first beat.

title: Copy a short grid from memory
description: Look at a short pattern, such as a three-by-three grid or up to six marks, cover it, and copy it.
oneStarDescription: Look at a three-by-three grid or a pattern of up to six marks long enough to try a copy.
twoStarDescription: Cover it and copy the marks.
threeStarDescription: Uncover the original and mark one cell or one mark that differs, or say the copy matched.

title: Copy a rhythm you just heard
description: Hear a short clapped rhythm and clap it back.
oneStarDescription: Listen once without clapping along.
twoStarDescription: Clap the rhythm back once, without adding an extra hit.
threeStarDescription: Ask whether it matched, and fix one hit if it did not.

title: Count a group in
description: Count a short preparation and have two people start together on the next beat.
oneStarDescription: Tell them which count is the start.
twoStarDescription: Give the count at a steady pace.
threeStarDescription: See whether they started together, and say if they did not.

title: Count a tempo aloud
description: Count a steady tempo aloud and stop on a number you chose.
oneStarDescription: Say the number you will stop on.
twoStarDescription: Count evenly up to the number you named, without adding an extra count.
threeStarDescription: Stop on that number, not the next.

title: Count on one hand in binary
description: Show the numbers from zero to five with finger positions you can explain.
oneStarDescription: Show two different positions and name them.
twoStarDescription: Show each number and say the fingers you used.
threeStarDescription: Let someone set a position you taught and say the number.

title: Cross a jump rope once
description: Jump a rope with one jump, then cross the arms for one jump and uncross.
oneStarDescription: Jump one plain jump and land on both feet.
twoStarDescription: Cross the arms for one jump.
threeStarDescription: After the crossed jump, return to one plain jump.

title: Cut a five-point star
description: Fold paper and cut one star, then open it and count the points.
oneStarDescription: Make the folds you planned.
twoStarDescription: Cut the outline in one sequence.
threeStarDescription: Open it and say how many points appeared.

title: Cut a paper loop and say what you get
description: Make a paper loop with a half twist, cut along it, and say what happened.
oneStarDescription: Make a loop with one half twist and mark the twist.
twoStarDescription: Cut along the middle. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can cut the loop.
threeStarDescription: Say whether you have one loop or two, and whether you predicted it.

title: Cut a row of paper people
description: Fold a strip and cut one figure so it opens into a row of figures holding hands.
oneStarDescription: Fold the paper into even layers.
twoStarDescription: Cut a person that touches both folded sides.
threeStarDescription: Open it and count the figures that stayed joined.

title: Cut a symmetric snowflake
description: Fold and cut a paper snowflake that opens into a matching pattern.
oneStarDescription: Fold the paper into matching layers.
twoStarDescription: Cut a small shape and open it.
threeStarDescription: Point to one shape that repeats, or say where the fold slipped.

title: Cut a window in card
description: Cut a window in card so a picture shows through and the border stays in one piece.
oneStarDescription: Draw the window smaller than the card.
twoStarDescription: Cut the window out. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can cut it.
threeStarDescription: Lay a picture behind it and say whether the border covers the edge.

title: Cut four pieces that fit back
description: Cut a picture card into four pieces and fit those pieces back into the rectangle.
oneStarDescription: Cut the card into four. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can make four pieces.
twoStarDescription: Turn them out of order. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can mix the pieces.
threeStarDescription: Fit them back and show the edges meet.

title: Deal a fan of cards
description: Spread a small fan of cards so each corner shows.
oneStarDescription: Start from a squared deck.
twoStarDescription: Spread a fan in one hand or on the table.
threeStarDescription: Close it back into a square.

title: Deal around a circle
description: Deal one card to each person in a small circle and stop when the turn returns to the start.
oneStarDescription: Point to the person who gets the first card.
twoStarDescription: Give one card to each person.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the next card would start a second round, unless you said you would continue.

title: Deal into two even piles
description: Deal a small even deck into two piles with the same count.
oneStarDescription: Count the cards before you deal.
twoStarDescription: Deal one to each pile until the deck is gone.
threeStarDescription: Count both piles and say they match, or where you misdealt.

title: Draw a circle with string
description: Draw a circle with a pin or a held center and a string, and mark the center.
oneStarDescription: Mark the point the string turns around.
twoStarDescription: Draw the circle with the string kept tight.
threeStarDescription: Measure from the center to the line in two places and say if they match.

title: Draw a hand as a simple shape
description: Draw a hand as a palm shape plus a thumb, and ask someone to point to the thumb.
oneStarDescription: Draw the palm as one shape.
twoStarDescription: Add the thumb where it joins.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to point to the thumb.
